# VIMAL JYOTHI ENGINEERING COLLEGE (AUTONOMOUS)

## Internal Exam Retest – VIIth Semester – 2023 Batch

**Subject:** CET415 – ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT ASSESSMENT
**Year/Semester:** Fourth Year / VIIth Semester
**Branch:** CEBS, EE, AD, CS, ME, CSD, CC, AE, EC
**Date of Exam:** 2026-10-19
**Duration:** 2 hours
**Starting Time:** 1.50 PM TO 3.50 PM
**Max. Marks:** 60

---

## PART A
### Answer All Questions

| Q No. | Question | Marks | CO | Level |
|-------|----------|-------|----|-------|
| 1. | Write any 3 drinking water quality parameters with their standards. | 3 | CO1 | L2 |
| 2. | Discuss the significance of public participation in EIA. | 3 | CO1 | L2 |
| 3. | Define noise pollution and list out common sources of noise pollution. | 3 | CO3 | L1 |
| 4. | Define the following terms: i) Impact Prediction ii) Socio economic Impacts | 3 | CO3 | L1 |
| 5. | Write any two impacts on the water environment due to any solid waste management project and suggest the mitigation measures. | 3 | CO5 | L1 |
| 6. | Write any three impacts of a quarry mining project. | 3 | CO5 | L1 |

---

## PART B
### Answer All Questions

| Q No. | Question | Marks | CO | Level |
|-------|----------|-------|----|-------|
| 7. | a) Explain why EIA is needed for developmental projects. (9 Marks) b) Discuss the limitations of Environmental Impact Assessment. (5 Marks) | 14 | CO1 | L2 |
| | **OR** | | | |
| 8. | Discuss in details about the Water (Prevention & Control of Pollution) Act 1974. | 14 | CO1 | L2 |
| 9. | Explain the valuation and Mitigation- Prediction and assessment of the impact on air. | 14 | CO3 | L2 |
| | **OR** | | | |
| 10. | How can air quality modelling help in assessing the impact on air? | 14 | CO3 | L2 |
| 11. | Explain an EIA case study of any highway widening project in Kerala in detail. | 14 | CO5 | L2 |
| | **OR** | | | |
| 12. | Explain the generic structure of an EIA in the case of any airport project. | 14 | CO5 | L2 |

---

**CO1:** Explain the need for minimizing the environmental impacts of developmental activities.
**CO3:** Apply various methodologies for assessing the environmental impacts of any developmental activity.
**CO5:** Prepare an environmental impact assessment report.

*\*Level: Knowledge level based on Blooms Taxonomy*
*[ L2 Understanding(U), L1 Remembering(R) ]*
